resources.string: Swipe an open app sideways with two or three fingers. Left sends it to the instrument cluster, which shows it in its navigation view. Right sends it to the passenger screen. To bring a window back, swipe left on the passenger screen or right over the home screen. Needs the window service and a firmware review of this operation.
